Here is a diplomatic transcription of the Latin baptismal register entries from **image_2138c0.png**.

The record is divided into two columns spanning the months of April, May, and June of **1862**. Standard Latin abbreviations (such as *filius/filia* for son/daughter, *sponsores* for godparents, and *P.P.* for Parish Priest) have been transcribed as written.
